reviewScope: Frozen final core state boards in core-states-10.jpg through core-states-17.jpg only. Read-only visual inspection; no image generation, rebuilding, renderer/copy/layout changes, Git operations, or F-drive writes.
method: Before repair, all assigned eight contact sheets (32 boards, 150 state entries) were actually visually inspected and six critical originals displayed full-size. After the final freeze, only craft-recipes--states-1.png and common-dialogs--states-1.png were actually displayed again at original size, confirming the ghost was removed. For all 32 assigned sources, an independent SHA256 check linked old sheet source hashes to repair-before hashes and current PNGs to repair-after hashes; independent Pillow RGB pixel differences against the preserved baseline were exactly [93,923,207,935], entirely below all state cards (bottom y=897). Thus the complete previous content/control review is reused for bit-identical card pixels. This is bounded-repair verification, not a claim that all current images or new contact sheets were re-viewed.

positiveObservations: 拾取、丢弃、食用、阅读、装填/卸出、液体、电子设备、修理、配件、制作/批量/拆解及设置状态正文均为具体玩家反馈；未见原先通用制作要求占位正文。
条件不满足的原操作使用灰色禁用控件，保留查看要求、调整数量、选择其他目标或安全返回。
腐败食物、收藏物丢弃、配件安装风险、收藏材料消耗、设置放弃、配色还原、教学退出和通用危险删除均可辨认后果与取消/继续编辑关系。
common-dialogs六条原尺寸核对一致：离开/继续编辑、删除世界/取消、确认数量/取消、查看地点/关闭、查看物品/返回、禁用条件不足/查看材料。
长标题熟练技艺不足导致时间惩罚、最长替代按钮和原尺寸三行区域未发现遮挡或超出卡片边界。
暂定名、设计预览、状态合同等画面外预览标记与README约定一致，不作为玩家状态正文。

findings.title: 状态网格下缘露出被遮盖基础脚注的少量字形
findings.observation: 六张原尺寸抽查图的状态网格外、左下边缘约x128–205/y930–935可见基础脚注“仅为美术排版”的字形下缘，呈不完整的灰绿文字。正文、按钮及状态合同脚注均未被其遮挡。
findings.sourceEvidence: craft-recipes--states-1 layout text-10 retains 样例数据\n仅为美术排版 at [93,882,220,56]; the displayed native PNG shows its lower glyph pixels beneath the overlaid state panel.
findings.suggestedFollowUp: 后续允许解冻时，在状态板组合前移除基础脚注或完整遮住其区域，再对变更哈希复核。当前按冻结约定未修改任何PNG/renderer/copy/layout。
findings.impact: 仅影响成图抛光，不改变状态文案、控件可读性、禁用与确认取消语义。
findings.resolution: The two newly displayed final originals show no partial old footnote below the grid. For every assigned source, independently recomputed pixel differences are limited to [93,923,207,935], below all cards; the artifact removal does not change any state content/control pixel.

findings.title: 审图期间源PNG发生顺序重绘，旧联系表不能代表当前图片
findings.observation: 初次写报告时15张源PNG已不同于联系表记录；随后核对看见pickup至keybindings连续更新且help文件被其他进程占用。当前再核对已有31张源PNG与所看联系表来源SHA不同。联系表本身仍为原哈希。
findings.suggestedFollowUp: 协调者完成重绘并冻结后更新联系表与来源SHA，重新实际查看更新联系表/关键原图，再给出最终通过状态。
findings.impact: 审图证据版本失配；不表示新PNG有同样外观或语义问题。
findings.resolution: Final batch frozen; all 32 proof-before hashes match old sheet source hashes, all 32 proof-after hashes match current PNG bytes, and actual preserved baseline/current pixel comparisons independently reproduce the same below-card delta bounds. Prior review validity is restored for unchanged state-card content, with two current originals actually re-viewed.

limitations: Picture/art-only acceptance; no Unity, gameplay runtime or interactive behavior validation.
Only eight originally viewed contact sheets / 32 assigned boards / 150 states are covered. This report does not claim an independent global 133-board diff audit.

All previous state content was visually reviewed. After the repair, exactly two final originals were visually displayed again; the other 30 state-content reviews are reused because independently verified changed pixels lie entirely below the cards. No claim is made that the full current batch or new contact sheets were re-viewed.

previousReviewRounds.notes: Complete content review was finished before a narrow ghost cleanup; initial acceptance was invalidated because a concurrent repair changed PNG hashes. Original sheet hashes and interrupted-audit source hashes are retained here and per source.

boundedRepairVerification.method: Independently hash the actual preserved baseline and current PNG files for each of the 32 assigned boards; compare old actually-viewed contact-sheet source SHA to proof before; compare current actual SHA to proof after; independently recompute Pillow ImageChops.difference in RGB and require exact delta bounding box [93,923,207,935]. Confirm all differences start below state-card bottom 897. Only two specified final originals are re-viewed; previous complete visual content review is reused for unchanged pixels.
